It’s okay, you can be honest. If you're anything like most patients who find us, the answer is probably more than a few. Before and afters, treatment breakdowns, injector credentials. Maybe even a Reddit thread or two. You're doing your homework. We love that. You should be. In an industry that's growing incredibly fast, where credentials and standards can sometimes feel blurry, that training matters more than ever. It shapes everything about how we approach treatments. Because when you understand the body as a whole, you can better assess anatomy, skin health, and the root cause behind a concern. That’s what allows us to maintain safety while working toward real results and giving you skin you love to live in. But to be entirely honest, medspa is a term we're a little at war with. PA-C Jess While we love that our patients feel relaxed and rejuvenated when they leave our office, we're definitely not a spa. We're a medical aesthetics practice led by a PA-C, meaning Jess is fully certified to diagnose, develop treatment plans, and prescribe medications. For our team and our patients, it’s deeper than vanity, aging, or beauty. It’s about the life you get to have when you love the skin you’re in. That’s why giving you the highest standard of care is something we take pretty personally. Aesthetic treatments might live in the beauty world, but they're still medical procedures. So, we treat them that way! If something isn’t right for you, we’ll tell you. We adhere to the highest safety standards, regardless of what the rest of the industry is doing. We only offer treatments we genuinely believe in. Medicine, Integrity, & Safety First. Always. /02. /01. /03. /04. You know what we think? Curiosity should be encouraged in medical aesthetics. Because the better you understand your options, the more confident you feel about your results. Every patient is on a unique, individualized journey toward feeling comfortable and confident in their own skin. Different skin tones, skin concerns, gender identities and life stages, our doors are open and welcoming to all. Whether you're navigating perimenopause, managing adult acne, seeking gender-affirming care, or simply curious about what treatments are out there, Modern Medspa is for you.
